verdict.rationale: The only evidence that Ollama pulls models from Hugging Face is a single community comment saying a new model on HF can be fetched with one 'ollama pull'. No first-party documentation in the pack describes Hugging Face integration. missing for 10: first-party docs on pulling Hugging Face models (syntax, supported formats such as GGUF, quantization selection), independent hands-on corroboration beyond one comment.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face

citations.quote: A new model on HF or Ollama registry? One 'ollama pull' and it's available.
